verdict.rationale: Whether a product's source is available under an open license is a fair question for a SaaS communications platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Quo publishing its source code or any open license. The published OpenAPI specification and the public MCP server are adjacent openness features, not source code, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
